features.summary: Several changes improve how pages behave and how Firefox handles their data: the `text-autospace-size` CSS property is now supported, the `color-scheme` meta tag affects `prefers-color-scheme`, and navigation and shadow-DOM features gain better support. Other updates make image maps, page loading, and content-list performance more reliable.
